title: RSS/Atom Feed Parser
description: Parses raw RSS or Atom feed XML text into a normalized array of items. Handles both RSS <item> and Atom <entry> formats, extracting id/guid, title, link, a plain-text snippet, and the published date. Malformed or missing fields are handled gracefully (missing values become null, unparseable dates are returned as-is).
whenToUse: Use when a workflow has fetched raw RSS/Atom XML (e.g. from an HTTP fetch node) and needs it converted into structured item objects for filtering, summarizing, or storage. Pair with an HTTP GET node that returns the feed body as text.

raw_xml.description: The raw RSS or Atom feed XML text to parse. May be provided via a template like {{nodes.fetch_feed.output.body}}.

max_items.description: Maximum number of items to return (newest-first as they appear in the feed). Defaults to 50.

items.description: Normalized feed items in feed order.

id.description: GUID (RSS) or entry id (Atom), or the link if no id exists, else null.

title.description: Item title, HTML-decoded, or null if missing.

link.description: Item link URL, or null if missing.

snippet.description: Plain-text excerpt from description/summary/content (tags stripped, truncated to ~300 chars), or null.

published.description: Publication date string from the feed (pubDate/published/updated), or null.

example.raw_xml: <?xml version="1.0"?><rss version="2.0"><channel><item><title>Example Post</title><link>https://example.com/post</link><guid>https://example.com/post</guid><pubDate>Tue, 03 Jun 2025 09:00:00 GMT</pubDate><description>A short summary of the post.</description></item></channel></rss>
